taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Pagination cursor binding across account, tenant and filters
controls.source_trace: Follow the continuation token into the resumed query. Check whether it preserves or overrides tenant, sort/filter and current entitlement rather than trusting issuance context forever.
controls.implementation_branch: Check whether the cursor carries authority or only a position; a signed position can still be safely re-authorized. Keep initial and resumed query filters visible. Sort-key changes, deleted rows and expiry can change a page without implying cross-tenant access; require an attributed unauthorized synthetic record.
controls.controlled_verification: Compare a legitimate next page with the same cursor under another owned actor or changed filter; inspect returned synthetic objects.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An opaque or unsigned cursor is not a flaw if the resumed query re-enforces policy; an empty page proves no data access.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind or revalidate cursor context and current authorization, preserving normal pagination and stable results.
